description:
Send one message through `phone_number_id` to a customer, in a text,
a template, an image or a document. Set `type` and the matching field.

Outside the 24-hour window, only a template goes through. A text, image
or document send is refused with `409 window_closed`. A template send
works any time and can start a new conversation.

The send does not take the conversation over, so the agent keeps
answering. Set `take_over: true` to stop the agent and answer yourself.

`Idempotency-Key` is required. The same key with the same body replays
the first answer instead of sending again.

(Tags: WhatsApp)

Idempotency-Key.description:
A unique string you choose, up to 255 characters. Required on this
route. The same key with the same body replays the first answer for
24 hours instead of acting twice. A different body with the same key
answers `409`.

media_id.description: The `media_id` from `uploadWhatsappMedia`, uploaded within the last 24 hours.

reply_to.description: A message id in the same conversation to quote. Not allowed with a template.

take_over.description: Stop the agent answering this conversation and let a person run it.

id.description: An approved template on this number, from `listWhatsappTemplates`.

params.description:
One value per field in the template's `fields`. Keys are
those field keys. String, number or null values.

to.description: The customer's number in international format, such as `+15551234567`.

name: sendWhatsappMessage
